aalborg-lounge-chair.c:
Textured upholstery 
Spot clean only, with a water-based upholstery shampoo or foam cleaner, never a solvent. Try the cleaner on a hidden spot first and do not overwet the fabric. Blot any spill straight away, working from the outside of the mark in towards the middle so it does not leave a ring. Vacuum often, or brush lightly with a stiff non-metallic brush, to lift dust and keep the texture looking fresh. Do not steam clean or use hot water extraction, and do not remove the cushion covers to launder them. When the whole piece needs a clean, call in a professional furniture cleaning service. Timber frame 
Dust with a soft, dry cloth, and wipe occasionally with a barely damp one, drying after. Keep out of direct sun and away from radiators to protect the wood. A note on natural variation 
Where natural materials such as wood are used, slight variations in grain and colour from one piece to the next are to be expected, and give each its own character.

alassio-round-teak-outdoor-coffee-table.m: Single round outdoor coffee table in Grade A teak, Almond Finish. Planks fill a round frame on legs that taper toward the ground, with plastic glides underfoot. Holds up to 800 lbs.
alassio-round-teak-outdoor-coffee-table.c:
Teak 
Teak's natural oils let it live outdoors. Left untreated, it weathers over time to a soft silver-grey; a teak protector or sealer, applied as its label directs, can hold the warmer tone if you prefer it, but is never required. To clean, wash with mild soapy water and a soft brush, rinse and let it dry. Never use a pressure washer, which raises the grain. Glides 
Check the plastic glides now and then and keep them clean of grit, so the piece slides without marking deck boards, stone or tile. Seasonal storage 
In harsh winter weather, cover the table with a breathable cover or store it somewhere dry and airy. A Note on Natural Variation 
Teak is a natural material, and grain, tone and small knots vary from board to board and piece to piece. As it weathers, colour shifts gradually; this is part of the character of the wood.

bardolino-18-inch-riveted-vanity.m: Freestanding bathroom vanity on a Jet metal frame, aged to a patina, with bolted corners. Side panels are engineered wood faced in a dark grain veneer. Countertop and basin are one black ceramic piece, drilled for an 8 in centerset faucet. One door on pivot hinges, a fixed false drawer front, black bar pulls, and an inside shelf cut out for plumbing. Pads underneath protect floors. No faucet or fixtures included.
bardolino-18-inch-riveted-vanity.c:
Wood finish 
The side panels are engineered wood with a wood-grain veneer. Dust with a soft, dry cloth, and wipe occasionally with a barely damp one, drying straight after. Wipe up splashes and standing water promptly, especially along the top edge of the cabinet and around the base and legs, and keep the bathroom well ventilated so moisture does not linger. Keep out of direct sun and away from radiators and heat vents. Ceramic basin 
The countertop and basin are ceramic, made in one piece. Clean with a mild, non-abrasive cleaner and a soft cloth, then rinse and wipe dry. Avoid scouring pads and harsh chemicals, which can dull the glaze. Metal frame 
The metal frame and pulls have an aged patina finish. Dust with a soft, dry cloth and wipe with a barely damp one when needed, drying straight away so water does not sit on the metal. Avoid abrasive cleaners and metal polishes, which can wear the patina. Installation 
Install and connect like any freestanding vanity, ideally by a licensed plumber. Once it is in place, check that it stands level and steady on the floor. A Note on Natural Variation 
Where natural materials such as wood are used, slight variations in grain and colour from one piece to the next are to be expected, and give each its own character.

bassano-3-light-swing-arm-pendant.m: Three-light pendant with swinging arms in satin brass and black powder-coated metal shades in Jet. Hanging rods adjust for height, with a ceiling canopy. Hang it over a dining table, kitchen island or living room. Takes three E26 bulbs, 40W maximum each or LED equivalent, not included. Dimmable with a dimmer switch, not included. Needs professional installation and assembly.
bassano-3-light-swing-arm-pendant.c:
Metal frame 
Dust the powder-coated shades and satin brass arms with a soft, dry cloth or a microfibre duster. Avoid abrasive cleaners, polishes and scouring pads, which can mark the finishes. Bulbs and wiring 
Switch off and let the bulbs cool before cleaning or changing them. Use E26 bulbs of no more than 40 watts each, or the LED equivalent. Installation 
Have the fixture installed by a qualified electrician, and switch off the power at the breaker before any work on it.

bastad-button-tufted-velvet-twin-bed.m: Twin platform bed upholstered in Alabaster performance velvet that resists stains, with a scalloped, arched headboard, button tufted for sitting up in bed, and silver-tone nailheads. Engineered wood frame on Jet wood legs with caps to protect floors. Wood slats rest on a reinforced centre beam with two support legs, and take memory foam, innerspring, latex or hybrid mattresses, no box spring needed. The headboard stands 60.5 to 68 inches high overall. Holds up to 800 lbs. Mattress not included. Assembly required.
bastad-button-tufted-velvet-twin-bed.c:
Velvet upholstery 
The performance velvet carries cleaning code S, which means spot cleaning only with a water-free dry-cleaning solvent, and no water or steam. Vacuum regularly to lift dust before it settles into the pile. Blot spills straight away rather than rubbing them. Before using any solvent, test it first on a small, hidden area. Wood frame 
Dust the legs and frame with a soft, dry cloth, and wipe up any spills on the wood promptly. Check and tighten the bolts now and then, the way you would with any bed frame. Nailhead trim 
Dust with a soft, dry cloth. Avoid abrasive or chemical cleaners, which can dull the metal. A Note on Velvet 
Velvet shows soft shading or pressure marks where the pile lies in different directions. This is a characteristic of the fabric and part of how it catches the light.

bayeux-arched-bookcase.m: Tall open bookcase with an arched top, in engineered wood. The arched surround comes in Jet, Willow, Loden or Sand, with a warm grain laminate inside. Four open tiers on shelves that adjust, each shelf holding up to 99 lbs. Suits a dining room, living room, hall or office. Assembly required.
bayeux-arched-bookcase.c:
Wood finish 
Dust with a soft, dry cloth, and wipe occasionally with a barely damp one, drying straight after. Wipe up spills and standing water promptly, and use coasters under glasses and mats under hot dishes on the top. Keep out of direct sun and away from radiators and heat vents. Stability 
Like any tall bookcase, this piece should be secured to the wall. Fit an anti-tip strap into a wall stud.

beaufort-curved-sideboard.m: Curved sideboard in a Hazel grain finish with vertical fluting. Two tiers of tambour doors slide open, with brass-tone pulls, over shelves that adjust and openings for cables. Use it as a dining buffet, a credenza or TV console, or storage in an office or entry. Assembly required.

Wipe the door pulls with a soft, dry cloth. Avoid abrasive or chemical cleaners, which can wear the finish.

beaulieu-upholstered-full-storage-bed.m: Full storage bed with a rounded, arched headboard and a padded frame sitting just wider than the mattress. Heathered woven fabric in Moss, Oyster, Mink, Chambray or Old Rose, over dense foam. The slatted platform needs no box spring and lifts on gas springs, pulled up by a strap at the foot, to open storage for bedding, pillows and clothes. Bumpers on the headboard stop the mattress sliding, and the legs carry caps to protect floors. A mattress under 12 in thick lifts most easily. Holds up to 700 lbs. Mattress not included. Assembly required.
beaulieu-upholstered-full-storage-bed.c:
Woven upholstery 
The fabric carries cleaning code S, which means spot clean only with a water-free dry-cleaning solvent. Never use water or steam on it. Blot any spill straight away rather than rubbing, test the cleaner on a hidden spot first, and vacuum regularly with a brush attachment to lift dust before it settles in. Keep out of prolonged direct sun, which fades fabric over time. Wood frame 
Check and tighten the bolts now and then, the way you would with any bed frame, so it stays solid and quiet. Storage platform 
Open and close the lift-up platform with the strap at the foot, letting the gas springs do the work rather than forcing it.

bembridge-2-piece-teak-outdoor-armchair-.m: Set of two outdoor armchairs in solid teak, Almond Finish, with curved arms and slatted backs. Seat and back cushions come in Navy, Alabaster or Slate outdoor fabric that resists water and UV, with covers that can go in the washing machine. Assembly required.
bembridge-2-piece-teak-outdoor-armchair-.c:
Outdoor cushions 
The outdoor fabric resists water and sun, but cushions last longest when they are kept dry. Water can work in through the seams, so cover the cushions or bring them in when the piece is not in use. After rain, stand cushions on edge so the water drains, and let them dry fully before sitting on them. Blot spills straight away and clean with mild soap and water; never use harsh chemicals. The covers are machine washable; follow the care label. In the off season, bring cushions in or store them somewhere dry. Teak frame 
Left untreated, teak weathers naturally to a soft silver-grey. To clean, wash with mild soapy water and a soft brush, rinse and let it dry. Do not use a pressure washer, which raises the grain. If you prefer to keep the honey colour, a teak protector or sealer can be applied; this is optional, never required. Seasonal storage 
Cover the piece or store it in a sheltered, dry place through harsh winter weather. A Note on Natural Variation 
Teak is a natural material, and every piece varies in grain, tone and small markings. Its colour shifts outdoors over time, from honey toward silver, which is part of its character.

bembridge-teak-outdoor-rectangular-coffe.c:
Teak 
Left untreated, teak weathers naturally to a soft silver-grey. To clean, wash with mild soapy water and a soft brush, rinse and let it dry. Do not use a pressure washer, which raises the grain. If you prefer to keep the honey colour, a teak protector or sealer can be applied; this is optional, never required. Wipe up spilled wine, oil and food promptly, and set hot dishes on trivets. Seasonal storage 
Cover the piece or store it in a sheltered, dry place through harsh winter weather. A Note on Natural Variation

bergamo-armchair.m: Club chair with squared, angular arms, upholstered in nubby bouclé over dense foam. The wood frame is built on sinuous springs, with caps and glides underneath to protect floors. An accent pillow comes with it.
bergamo-armchair.c:
Bouclé upholstery 
This fabric carries cleaning code S: spot clean only, with a dry-cleaning solvent that contains no water. Never use water or steam on the fabric. Blot any spill straight away rather than rubbing, and try a cleaner on a hidden spot first. Vacuum regularly with a brush attachment, and keep out of prolonged direct sun, which fades fabric over time. If a loop snags, trim it with small scissors rather than pulling it.

berlin-2-piece-double-chaise-loveseat.m: Two-piece double-chaise loveseat: an armless chaise facing left and an armless chaise facing right. Upholstered in performance fabric that shrugs off spills, with piped edges, on a frame of mixed woods with protective caps under each foot. Seats are built on pocket coils wrapped in dense foam. Pieces lock together with connectors.
berlin-2-piece-double-chaise-loveseat.c: Upholstery Vacuum lightly with a brush attachment and blot spills immediately rather than rubbing. The performance fabric is hard-wearing and forgiving; for a deeper clean, a professional upholstery service is safest. Keep out of prolonged direct sun, which fades fabric. Modular sections The pieces are made to separate and reconfigure; re-seat them and check the connectors now and then so seams stay tight and the sections sit flush. A note on modular living Expect the cushions to soften and settle with use, and give the sections an occasional nudge back together. It's the nature of a piece built to move with you.

The performance fabric is hard-wearing and forgiving; for a deeper clean, a professional upholstery service is safest. Keep out of prolonged direct sun, which fades fabric. Modular sections The pieces are made to separate and reconfigure; re-seat them and check the connectors now and then so seams stay tight and the sections sit flush. A note on modular living Expect the cushions to soften and settle with use, and give the sections an occasional nudge back together. It's the nature of a piece built to move with you.

berlin-ottoman.m: Single ottoman with clean, broad lines, made to pair with the other Berlin modular pieces. Upholstered in high-performance fabric that repels water-based spills and stains, with piped edges, on a frame of mixed woods with protective caps under each foot. Built on pocket coils wrapped in dense foam. Pieces lock together with connectors.
berlin-ottoman.c:
Performance fabric upholstery 
The fabric is made to repel water-based spills and stains, so most marks can be blotted up with a clean cloth. For anything that remains, spray lightly with a diluted dish soap solution and blot clean. Vacuum regularly with a brush attachment, and keep out of prolonged direct sun, which fades fabric over time.

beton-bullnose-cement-finish-coffee-tabl.m: Rectangular coffee table in MDF and hardwood with a textured cement finish, offered in several finishes. Rounded bullnose edges sit on two slab legs, with levelling feet that protect floors. Holds up to 287 lbs. Assembly required.
beton-bullnose-cement-finish-coffee-tabl.c:
Cement finish 
Wipe with a soft cloth, dry or barely damp, and dry straight after. Use coasters under glasses and mats under hot dishes, and wipe up spills straight away, especially wine, coffee, citrus and oil, which can mark the textured surface. Avoid abrasive, acidic or harsh cleaners and scouring pads. A Note on Natural Variation 
Cement finishes show slight variations in texture, tone and small surface pores from one piece to the next. These are to be expected, and give each its own character.

beverley-cane-panel-full-bed.m: Full platform bed on a 100% solid hardwood frame finished in Chestnut or Jet, with tapered legs. The headboard holds three panels of woven synthetic cane and mounts at any of three heights. Engineered wood slats support the mattress and let it breathe, with no box spring needed, and take memory foam, latex, innerspring or hybrid mattresses. Holds up to 794 lbs. Mattress not included. Assembly required.
beverley-cane-panel-full-bed.c:
Wood frame 
Dust with a soft, dry cloth, and wipe occasionally with a barely damp one, drying straight after. Keep out of direct sun and away from radiators and heat vents. Check and tighten the bolts now and then, as you would with any bed frame. Cane 
The woven synthetic cane panels can be brushed gently, or vacuumed with a soft brush attachment, and wiped with a barely damp cloth. Keep them away from radiators and heat vents. A Note on Natural Variation 
Where natural materials such as wood are used, slight variations in grain and colour from one piece to the next are to be expected, and give each its own character.

blakeney-arched-upholstered-full-bed.m: Full upholstered platform bed with a half-round arched headboard, low padded side rails and footboard. Heathered woven fabric in Heathered Cream, Heathered Stone or Heathered Charcoal over dense foam, on an engineered wood frame and laminated wood legs with caps to protect floors. Wooden slats take a standard full mattress, latex, hybrid, innerspring or memory foam, no box spring needed. Holds up to 800 lbs. Assembly required. Mattress not included.
blakeney-arched-upholstered-full-bed.c:
Woven upholstery 
The heathered woven fabric carries cleaning code S, which means spot cleaning with a water-free dry-cleaning solvent only, with no water or steam. Vacuum regularly to lift dust before it settles in. Blot spills straight away rather than rubbing. Before using any solvent cleaner, test it first on a small hidden area. Wood frame 
Check and tighten the bolts now and then, as you would with any bed frame, to keep it steady and quiet. Wipe up any spills or standing water on the slats promptly. Wood legs 
The legs are laminated veneer lumber, a strong structural wood built up from bonded layers of veneer. Dust with a soft, dry cloth, wipe occasionally with a barely damp one and dry straight after, and wipe up any standing water promptly. Keep out of direct sun and away from radiators and heat vents.

blakeney-full-storage-bed.m: Full storage bed with a rounded, arched headboard, upholstered in heathered woven fabric, Old Rose, Oyster, Moss, Mink or Chambray, over dense foam. The slatted platform needs no box spring and rises on gas springs, pulled up by a strap at the foot, to open space for spare blankets, pillows and out-of-season clothes. Stoppers on the headboard hold the mattress in place, and caps on the legs protect floors. Takes memory foam, innerspring, latex or hybrid mattresses, best under 12 in thick for easy lifting. Holds up to 700 lbs. Mattress not included. Assembly required.
blakeney-full-storage-bed.c:
Woven upholstery 
The heathered polyester weave carries cleaning code S, which means it should be cleaned only with a water-free dry-cleaning solvent, never with water or steam. Vacuum regularly to lift dust before it settles in. Blot spills straight away rather than rubbing, working from the outside of the mark in toward the centre. Before using any cleaner, test it on a small, hidden area first. Frame and gas lift 
Wipe the frame and legs with a soft, dry cloth when you change the bedding. Check and tighten the bolts now and then, the way you would with any bed frame. Raise and lower the storage platform using the strap at the foot, and keep hands clear of the lift as it closes.

Stoppers on the headboard hold the mattress in place, and caps on the legs protect floors. Takes memory foam, innerspring, latex or hybrid mattresses, best under 12 in thick for easy lifting. Holds up to 700 lbs. Mattress not included. Assembly required.
blakeney-velvet-king-storage-bed.c:
Velvet upholstery 
The polyester performance velvet carries cleaning code S, which means it should be cleaned only with a water-free dry-cleaning solvent, never with water or steam. Vacuum regularly to lift dust before it settles in. Blot spills straight away rather than rubbing, working from the outside of the mark in toward the centre. Before using any cleaner, test it on a small, hidden area first. Frame and gas lift 
Wipe the frame and legs with a soft, dry cloth when you change the bedding. Check and tighten the bolts now and then, the way you would with any bed frame. Raise and lower the storage platform using the strap at the foot, and keep hands clear of the lift as it closes. A Note on Velvet 
Velvet shows soft shading or pressure marks where the pile lies in different directions. This is a characteristic of the fabric and part of how it catches the light.

bodmin-fretwork-sideboard.c:
Wood finish 
Dust with a soft, dry cloth, and wipe occasionally with a barely damp one, drying straight after. Wipe up spills and standing water promptly so moisture doesn't reach the core. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth, or a barely damp one for marks, and dry straight after. Avoid abrasive cleaners and scouring pads, which can scratch the finish. A Note on Natural Variation 
Where natural materials such as wood are used, slight variations in grain and colour from one piece to the next are to be expected, and give each its own character.

bourton-round-post-vegan-leather-full-be.m: Full platform bed with low posts, a tall padded headboard to lean against and a lower padded footboard, both covered in Caramel vegan leather. Round solid wood posts in Almond or Chestnut on a kiln-dried wood frame. Wood slats take a standard full mattress, no box spring needed. Holds up to 794 lbs. Mattress not included. Assembly required.
bourton-round-post-vegan-leather-full-be.c:
Vegan leather upholstery 
For everyday dust, wipe gently with a clean, soft, dry cloth. For a stubborn mark, use a clean cloth that is only slightly damp and well wrung out, rubbing gently in small circles with the grain of the material. Repeat on heavier soiling rather than scrubbing hard, and avoid working a damp cloth over one spot for long, which can harm the faux leather. For ink or marker, first test a small, hidden area with a cotton swab dipped in a little alcohol to check the colour does not lift. If it holds, wipe the mark gently with the swab, follow with a wrung-out damp cloth, then blot up excess moisture with a clean, dry cloth and let it air dry in the shade. Never use gasoline, strong acids, strong alkalis or organic solvents, which damage the surface coating. Keep away from high temperatures, direct heat and prolonged sun, which can cause cracking. Wood frame 
Dust the posts and rails with a soft, dry cloth, and wipe occasionally with a barely damp one, drying straight after. Keep the bed out of direct sun and away from radiators and heat vents to protect the wood. Check and tighten the bolts now and then, as you would with any bed frame. A Note on Natural Variation 
Where natural materials such as wood are used, slight variations in grain and colour from one piece to the next are to be expected, and give each its own character.

brancaster-teak-outdoor-armchair.m: Single outdoor armchair in Grade A solid teak, Almond Finish, with slatted sides and back. Seat and back cushions are covered in outdoor fabric made to stand up to sun, rain, stains and fading, with covers that can go in the washing machine. Plastic glides underfoot protect surfaces. Holds up to 800 lbs.
brancaster-teak-outdoor-armchair.c:
Outdoor cushions 
After rain, stand the cushions on edge so water drains away and air reaches both faces, and let them dry right through before sitting. Blot spills straight away and clean marks with mild soap and lukewarm water, then rinse. The covers are machine washable; follow the care label and let them air dry. Bring cushions indoors, or store them somewhere dry, in the off season. Teak frame 
Left untreated, teak weathers naturally to a soft silver-grey. To clean, wash it with mild soapy water and a soft brush, working along the grain, then rinse and let it dry. Do not use a pressure washer, which raises the grain. If you prefer to keep the honey colour, a teak protector or sealer can be applied; this is optional, never required. Glides 
The feet sit on non-marking plastic glides. Clear away grit from under them now and then so they move cleanly over a deck or stone. Seasonal storage 
In harsh winter weather, cover the pieces with a breathable cover or store them in a dry, airy place, such as a garage or shed. Avoid wrapping them tightly in plastic, which traps moisture. A Note on Natural Variation 
Teak is a natural material, and every piece differs in grain, colour and the odd small knot or mineral streak. These differences, and the way the wood mellows outdoors, are part of its character.

dartmouth-46-inch-teak-outdoor-coffee-ta.c:
Teak 
Teak's natural oils let it live outdoors. Left untreated, it weathers over time to a soft silver-grey; a teak protector or sealer, applied as its label directs, can hold the warmer tone if you prefer it, but is never required. To clean, wash with mild soapy water and a soft brush, rinse and let it dry. Never use a pressure washer, which raises the grain. Glides 
Check the plastic glides now and then and keep them clean of grit, so the piece slides without marking deck boards, stone or tile. Seasonal storage 
In harsh winter weather, cover the table with a breathable cover or store it somewhere dry and airy. A Note on Natural Variation 
Teak is a natural material, and grain, tone and small knots vary from board to board and piece to piece. As it weathers, colour shifts gradually; this is part of the character of the wood.

ericeira-3-piece-teak-outdoor-modular-so.c:
Outdoor cushions 
Let cushions dry fully after rain, and stand them on edge so water drains out. Blot spills straight away, then clean with mild soap and water and rinse. Bring them in, or store them in a dry place, through the off season. The covers are removable. Teak frame 
Teak's natural oils let it live outdoors. Left untreated, it weathers over time to a soft silver-grey; a teak protector or sealer, applied as its label directs, can hold the warmer tone if you prefer it, but is never required. To clean, wash with mild soapy water and a soft brush, rinse and let it dry. Never use a pressure washer, which raises the grain. On darker finishes, sun and rain gradually soften and lighten the colour. Glides 
Check the plastic glides now and then and keep them clean of grit, so the piece slides without marking deck boards, stone or tile. Seasonal storage 
In harsh winter weather, cover the piece with a breathable cover or store it somewhere dry and airy. Bring cushions indoors for the off season. A Note on Natural Variation 
Teak is a natural material, and grain, tone and small knots vary from board to board and piece to piece. As it weathers, colour shifts gradually; this is part of the character of the wood.

Let cushions dry fully after rain, and stand them on edge so water drains out. Blot spills straight away, then clean with mild soap and water and rinse. Bring them in, or store them in a dry place, through the off season. The covers are removable. Teak frame 
Teak's natural oils let it live outdoors. Left untreated, it weathers over time to a soft silver-grey; a teak protector or sealer, applied as its label directs, can hold the warmer tone if you prefer it, but is never required. To clean, wash with mild soapy water and a soft brush, rinse and let it dry. Never use a pressure washer, which raises the grain. On darker finishes, sun and rain gradually soften and lighten the colour. Glides 
Check the plastic glides now and then and keep them clean of grit, so the piece slides without marking deck boards, stone or tile. Seasonal storage 
In harsh winter weather, cover the piece with a breathable cover or store it somewhere dry and airy. Bring cushions indoors for the off season. A Note on Natural Variation 
Teak is a natural material, and grain, tone and small knots vary from board to board and piece to piece. As it weathers, colour shifts gradually; this is part of the character of the wood.

estremoz-marble-top-side-table.m: Round side table with a solid marble top on a hardwood cross base: two slab legs that slot together, with wide, flat feet and floor protectors that adjust. The veining differs from one top to the next. For a living room or bedroom, or as a drinks table or plant stand. Holds up to 33 lbs. Assembly required.
estremoz-marble-top-side-table.c:
Marble top 
Marble is porous, so wipe up spills straight away, especially wine, coffee, citrus and oil, and use coasters under glasses and hot dishes. Clean with a soft cloth and a little mild soap in water, then dry. Avoid acidic or abrasive cleaners, which can etch or dull the stone. Wood base 
Dust with a soft, dry cloth, and wipe occasionally with a barely damp one, drying straight after. Keep out of direct sun and away from radiators and heat vents to protect the wood. A Note on Natural Variation 
Where natural materials such as wood and marble are used, slight variations in grain, veining and colour from one piece to the next are to be expected, and give each its own character.

etretat-curved-2-drawer-nightstand.m: Bedside table with two deep drawers, in engineered wood with a smooth Almond or Hazel grain laminate. The drawer fronts curve, with no handles, over a shaped plinth. Each drawer is about 15.2 in deep, 14 in wide and 5.8 in high inside. For a bedroom, living room or guest room. Assembly required.
etretat-curved-2-drawer-nightstand.c:
Wood finish 
Dust with a soft, dry cloth, and wipe occasionally with a barely damp one, drying straight after. Wipe up standing water promptly. Use coasters under glasses and hot dishes on the top, and keep the piece out of direct sun and away from radiators and heat vents. Stability 
Like any nightstand, this piece should be secured to the wall. Fit an anti-tip strap into a wall stud, and open one drawer at a time.

etretat-slipcovered-accent-chair.m: Round accent chair dressed in a tailored slipcover of soft linen-blend fabric with fine seam details, held on by hidden velcro and removable. The down-blend seat cushion lifts out and rests on sinuous springs, and its cover comes off and can be spot cleaned. Wooden legs on glides that protect floors. Simple setup.
etretat-slipcovered-accent-chair.c:
Linen-blend upholstery 
Spot clean only, with a water-based upholstery shampoo or foam cleaner, never a solvent. Try the cleaner on a hidden spot first and do not overwet the fabric. Blot any spill straight away, working from the outside of the mark in towards the middle so it does not leave a ring. Vacuum often, or brush lightly with a stiff non-metallic brush, to lift dust and keep the texture looking fresh. Do not steam clean or use hot water extraction, and do not remove the cushion covers to launder them. When the whole piece needs a clean, call in a professional furniture cleaning service. Timber legs 
Dust with a soft, dry cloth, and wipe occasionally with a barely damp one, drying after. Keep away from radiators to protect the wood. A note on natural variation 
Where natural materials such as wood are used, slight variations in grain and colour from one piece to the next are to be expected, and give each its own character.

evian-30-inch-fluted-wood-vanity.m: Freestanding bathroom vanity in 100% solid hardwood, Chestnut, with a fluted circle on the door front, brass-finish legs and round knobs with a concave face. The ceramic top and basin are one piece, White or Jet, drilled for an 8-inch widespread faucet. Two doors over a shelf that adjusts. No faucet or fixtures included. Assembly required.
evian-30-inch-fluted-wood-vanity.c:
Wood frame 
Dust with a soft, dry cloth, and wipe occasionally with a barely damp one, drying straight after. Wipe up splashes and standing water promptly, especially around the top edge and the base, and keep the bathroom well ventilated so moisture does not linger. Keep out of direct sun and away from radiators and heat vents. Ceramic basin 
Clean the basin and integrated counter with a mild, non-abrasive cleaner and a soft cloth, then rinse and wipe dry. Avoid scouring pads and harsh chemicals, which can dull the glaze. Brass-finish hardware 
Wipe the brass-finish legs and knobs with a soft, dry cloth. Avoid abrasive cleaners and metal polishes, which can wear through the finish. Installation 
Install and connect this vanity as you would any freestanding vanity, ideally by a plumber. A Note on Natural Variation 
Where natural materials such as wood are used, slight variations in grain and colour from one piece to the next are to be expected, and give each its own character.

ischia-teak-outdoor-folding-side-table.c:
Teak 
Left untreated, teak weathers naturally to a soft silver-grey. To clean, wash it with mild soapy water and a soft brush, working along the grain, then rinse and let it dry. Do not use a pressure washer, which raises the grain. If you prefer to keep the honey colour, a teak protector or sealer can be applied; this is optional, never required. Seasonal storage 
Fold the piece and store it in a dry, airy place, such as a garage or shed, through harsh winter weather. Avoid wrapping it tightly in plastic, which traps moisture against the wood. A Note on Natural Variation 
Teak is a natural material, and every piece differs in grain, colour and the odd small knot or mineral streak. These differences, and the way the wood mellows outdoors, are part of its character.

To clean, wash with mild soapy water and a soft brush, rinse and let it dry. Never use a pressure washer, which raises the grain. Foot caps 
Check the foot caps now and then and keep them free of grit, so the piece does not mark deck boards, stone or tile. Seasonal storage 
In harsh winter weather, cover the piece with a breathable cover or store it somewhere dry and airy. The cushions lift off; bring them indoors for the off season. A Note on Natural Variation 
Teak is a natural material, and grain, tone and small knots vary from board to board and piece to piece. As it weathers, colour shifts gradually; this is part of the character of the wood.

Teak is a natural material, and grain, tone and small knots vary from board to board and piece to piece. As it weathers, colour shifts gradually; this is part of the character of the wood.

ojai-down-filled-sleeper-sofa.c: Upholstery Vacuum lightly with a brush attachment and blot spills immediately rather than rubbing. If the covers are removable, follow their care label; otherwise a professional upholstery clean is safest. Keep out of prolonged direct sun, which fades fabric. Down-filled cushions The important one: down and feather cushions are soft by design and compress as you use them. Plump and rotate them regularly, ideally after each use, to keep that full, cloud-like shape. A cushion that looks flat usually just needs a good fluff, not replacing. Sleeper mechanism Open and close the pull-out gently and fully, don't sit on it mid-fold, and keep the track clear so it runs smoothly. A note on down comfort Deep, down-topped seating settles, softens, and wrinkles with use; regular plumping keeps it full, and that relaxed, lived-in look is part of the character.

The cushion fabric is made for outdoor use and resists weather and stains. Blot spills straight away, then clean any mark with mild soap and water and rinse. The covers are removable for washing; follow the care label and let them dry fully before refitting. After rain, stand the cushions on edge so they drain, and let them dry fully before sitting. Bring them in or store them in a dry place in the off season. Aluminum frame 
Wipe with mild soapy water, rinse and dry with a soft cloth. Avoid abrasive pads and harsh cleaners, which can scratch the powder coat. Faux-wood finish 
The wood look is a finish on the aluminum, not timber, so it needs no oiling, sanding or sealing. Clean it the same way as the frame, with a soft cloth and mild soapy water, and keep scouring pads and solvents away from it. Seasonal storage 
In harsh winter weather, cover the piece or move it under shelter, and keep the cushions indoors.

Assembly required.

pickering-scalloped-3-door-media-cabinet.c:
Solid wood 
Dust with a soft, dry cloth, and wipe occasionally with a barely damp one, drying straight after. Use coasters under glasses and mats under hot dishes on the top, and keep the piece out of direct sun and away from radiators and heat vents. A soft brush lifts dust from the carved scallops. A Note on Natural Variation 
Where natural materials such as wood are used, slight variations in grain and colour from one piece to the next are to be expected, and give each its own character.

piran-marble-top-dining-table.c:
Marble top

Brush or vacuum gently with a soft brush attachment, and wipe now and then with a barely damp cloth. Keep away from heat and direct sun, which dry the fibres. A Note on Natural Variation

plockton-swivel-dining-chair.m: Swivel dining chair whose scalloped back flows into gently flared, rounded arms, turning 360 degrees on a hidden base under a cover tailored to the floor. Linen-blend fabric in Oat Ticking Stripe, Chambray Ticking Stripe, Cream, Mushroom or Olive, over dense foam with a supportive back. Seat height 19.5 in. For a dining table, breakfast nook or eat-in kitchen. Holds up to 300 lbs. Arrives assembled.
plockton-swivel-dining-chair.c:
Fabric upholstery 
The fabric carries cleaning code W, which means water-based cleaning only. Spot clean with a water-based upholstery shampoo or foam cleaner, never a solvent, and test on a small hidden area first. Do not overwet. Vacuum often, or brush lightly with a stiff, non-metallic bristle brush, to lift dust and grime before it settles in. Blot spills straight away, working from the outside of the mark in toward the centre so it doesn't spread into a ring. Hot-water extraction and steam cleaning are not recommended, and the cover should not be removed and laundered. Once the chair looks soiled overall, use a professional furniture cleaning service.

polperro-channel-tufted-boucle-twin-trun.m: Twin daybed with a low, channel-tufted back and padded arms in Cream bouclé, and a second twin bed on casters that pulls out from beneath. Wood slats on each level take a standard twin mattress, no box spring needed. Holds up to 300 lbs. Mattresses not included. Assembly required.
polperro-channel-tufted-boucle-twin-trun.c:
Bouclé upholstery 
Vacuum lightly with a brush attachment to lift dust from the loops. Blot spills straight away rather than rubbing them, and for anything more, use a professional upholstery cleaner. Keep out of prolonged direct sun. If a loop snags, trim it with small scissors rather than pulling it. Wood frame 
Check and tighten the bolts now and then, the way you would with any bed frame, to keep it feeling solid. Keep the trundle casters free of dust and hair so it rolls out smoothly.

polperro-channel-tufted-velvet-twin-trun.m: Twin daybed with a low, channel-tufted back and padded arms in performance velvet that resists stains, Fawn, Aegean, Moss or Blush, and a second twin bed on casters that pulls out from beneath. Wood slats on each level take a standard twin mattress, no box spring needed. Holds up to 300 lbs. Mattresses not included. Assembly required.
polperro-channel-tufted-velvet-twin-trun.c:
Velvet upholstery 
The performance velvet carries cleaning code S, which means spot cleaning only with a water-free dry-cleaning solvent, and no water or steam. Vacuum regularly to lift dust before it settles in. Blot spills straight away rather than rubbing. Before using any cleaner, test it on a small, hidden area first. Wood frame 
The wood slat support sits beneath the mattress. Check and tighten the bolts now and then, as you would with any bed frame. Keep the trundle casters free of hair and dust so the lower bed rolls out smoothly. A Note on Velvet 
Velvet shows soft shading or pressure marks where the pile lies in different directions. This is a characteristic of the fabric and part of how it catches the light.

ponza-aluminum-outdoor-armchair.m: Single outdoor armchair on a powder-coated aluminum frame in Charcoal, with sloping arms and a gentle recline. Seat and back cushions in Pewter fabric that resists UV and water, with zippered covers that come off. Plastic glides underfoot. Holds up to 300 lbs. Assembly required.
ponza-aluminum-outdoor-armchair.c:
Outdoor cushions 
Let cushions dry fully after rain, and stand them on edge so water drains out. Blot spills straight away, then clean with mild soap and water and rinse. Bring them in, or store them in a dry place, through the off season. The covers zip off for cleaning. Aluminum frame 
Wipe with mild soapy water, rinse and dry. Avoid abrasive pads and harsh cleaners, which can scratch the powder coat. Aluminum does not rust, so the frame can stay out through the season. Glides 
Check the plastic glides now and then and keep them clean of grit, so the piece slides without marking deck boards, stone or tile. Seasonal storage 
In harsh winter weather, cover the piece with a breathable cover or store it somewhere dry and airy. Bring cushions indoors for the off season.

porvoo-faux-shearling-armchair.c:
Faux shearling upholstery 
Spot clean only, with a dry-cleaning solvent that contains no water. Never use water or steam on the fabric. Blot any spill straight away rather than rubbing, and try a cleaner on a hidden spot first. Vacuum regularly with a brush attachment, and keep out of prolonged direct sun, which fades fabric over time. Timber frame 
Dust with a soft, dry cloth, and wipe occasionally with a barely damp one, drying after. Keep out of direct sun and away from radiators to protect the wood. A note on natural variation

procida-2-piece-teak-outdoor-sectional-l.m: Two-piece outdoor sectional loveseat: a left-arm chair and a right-arm chair on bases of solid teak in Almond Finish with a richly textured grain. Seat and back cushions in Alabaster outdoor fabric that resists water and UV, with covers that can go in the washing machine. Assembly required.
procida-2-piece-teak-outdoor-sectional-l.c:
Outdoor cushions 
After rain, stand the cushions on edge so water drains away and air reaches both faces, and let them dry right through before sitting. Blot spills straight away and clean marks with mild soap and lukewarm water, then rinse. The covers are machine washable; follow the care label and let them air dry. Bring cushions indoors, or store them somewhere dry, in the off season. Teak frame 
Left untreated, teak weathers naturally to a soft silver-grey. To clean, wash it with mild soapy water and a soft brush, working along the grain, then rinse and let it dry. Do not use a pressure washer, which raises the grain. If you prefer to keep the honey colour, a teak protector or sealer can be applied; this is optional, never required. Seasonal storage 
In harsh winter weather, cover the pieces with a breathable cover or store them in a dry, airy place, such as a garage or shed. Avoid wrapping them tightly in plastic, which traps moisture. A Note on Natural Variation 
Teak is a natural material, and every piece differs in grain, colour and the odd small knot or mineral streak. These differences, and the way the wood mellows outdoors, are part of its character.

Spot clean only, with a dry-cleaning solvent that contains no water. Never use water or steam on the fabric. Blot any spill straight away rather than rubbing, and try a cleaner on a hidden spot first. Vacuum regularly with a brush attachment, and keep out of prolonged direct sun, which fades fabric over time. Metal legs 
Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Avoid abrasive cleaners, which can scratch the finish.

risskov-leather-armchair.m: Mid-century accent armchair in top-grain leather with curved, sloping arms and a pillowy back cushion that rises above the frame. Dense foam on a plywood frame with spring coil support, standing on legs of metal powder-coated in black, with caps underfoot. Cushions have zippered covers that come off. Ships boxed; assembly required.
risskov-leather-armchair.c:
Leather upholstery 
Blot a fresh spill straight away by pressing gently with a clean, soft cloth; do not rub back and forth, which spreads the stain. Once a week, wipe along the grain with a dry, lint-free cloth to lift dust. For a stubborn mark, mix a very little mild dish soap into lukewarm water, wring a cloth out until it is almost dry and dab the mark gently, then wipe away any soap with a second clean, damp cloth and let it air-dry in a cool, shaded spot. Keep at least two feet from heaters and out of direct sun, which fades leather over time. Metal legs 
Wipe with a soft, dry cloth, or a barely damp one, drying straight after. Avoid abrasive cleaners, which can scratch the finish. A note on natural variation 
Leather is a natural material, so slight variations in grain, markings and colour from one hide to the next are to be expected, and give each piece its own character.

risskov-leather-loveseat.m: Mid-century loveseat in top-grain leather with curved arms and pillowy back cushions, over dense foam on a plywood frame with spring coil support, on black powder-coated metal legs with caps underfoot. Cushions have zippered covers that come off.
risskov-leather-loveseat.c:
Leather 
The leather carries a stain-resistant protective coating that helps it shed water-based spills. Blot a fresh spill straight away with a clean, soft cloth, pressing rather than rubbing so the stain does not spread. Once a week, wipe along the grain with a dry, lint-free cloth to lift dust. For a stubborn mark, mix a little neutral dish soap into lukewarm water, wring a cloth out until nearly dry and dab gently, then wipe away any soap with a separate damp cloth and let it air dry in a cool, shaded spot. Keep the piece at least 2 feet from heat sources and out of direct sun, which fades all materials over time.

Hidden casters let you roll it into place. For a dining room, kitchen table or entry. Arrives assembled.
salcombe-slipcovered-dining-chair.c:
Fabric upholstery 
The linen-blend fabric carries cleaning code W, which means water-based cleaning only. Spot clean only, with a water-based upholstery shampoo or a foam upholstery cleaner, and test it first on a small, hidden area. Do not overwet, do not use solvents, and do not use steam or hot-water extraction. The covers should not be removed and laundered. Vacuum often, or brush lightly with a stiff, non-metallic brush, to lift dust and grime and keep the weave looking its best. Blot spills straight away, working from the outside of the mark in toward the centre so it doesn't spread into a ring. Once the chair is soiled overall, use a professional furniture cleaning service.

sanary-2-piece-curved-rope-back-aluminum.m: Two-piece curved outdoor modular sofa, a left-arm piece and a right-arm piece, on a powder-coated aluminum frame with a curved back of tightly wound outdoor rope. Foam seat and back cushions, the seat 6 in thick, in weather-resistant 100% polyester outdoor fabric, with the seat cushions held by hook-and-loop fasteners. Each piece holds up to 600 lbs. Assembly required.
sanary-2-piece-curved-rope-back-aluminum.c:
Outdoor cushions 
The cushion fabric is a weather-resistant polyester made for outdoor living. Deal with spills straight away: work the mark gently with a soft-bristled brush, a little mild soap and lukewarm water, then rinse until no soap remains and let the fabric air dry. Washing by hand is kindest to it and helps it last. Keep bleach and fabric softener away from the fabric. After rain, stand the cushions on edge so they drain and dry right through. Rope weave 
Brush away leaves and dust, then wipe the rope with mild soapy water and a soft cloth or brush. Rinse, and let it dry completely. Avoid bleach and harsh solvents. Aluminum frame 
Wipe with mild soapy water, rinse and dry with a soft cloth. Avoid abrasive pads and harsh cleaners, which can scratch the powder coat. Seasonal storage 
In harsh winter weather, cover the pieces or move them under shelter, and keep the cushions indoors.

Vacuum often, or brush lightly with a stiff non-metallic brush, to lift dust and grime; looped and pile fabrics may need the same brushing to restore their look. sausalito-2-piece-aluminum-outdoor-secti.m: Two-piece outdoor sectional, a right-arm loveseat and a left-arm chaise, with seat and back cushions of dense foam in solution-dyed polyester outdoor fabric that resists water and UV, with covers that come off, on powder-coated aluminum frames with glides underfoot. Each piece holds up to 661 lbs. Assembly required.
sausalito-2-piece-aluminum-outdoor-secti.c:
Outdoor cushions 
The solution-dyed polyester fabric is made to live outside and resists sun and rain. Treat a spill or mark straight away: work in a little mild soap and lukewarm water with a soft-bristled brush, then rinse until no soap is left and let the fabric dry in the air. The covers are removable, and washing them by hand is the gentler choice that helps the cushions last. Keep bleach and fabric softener away from the fabric. After rain, stand the cushions on edge so they drain, and let them dry fully before sitting. Bring them in or store them somewhere dry in the off season. Aluminum frame 
Wipe with mild soapy water, rinse and dry with a soft cloth. Avoid abrasive pads and harsh cleaners, which can scratch the powder coat. Aluminum does not rust, so the frame can stay outside through the season. Glides 
Check the glides now and then and keep them clean of grit, so the piece moves without marking deck boards, stone or tile. Lift rather than drag it when moving it. Seasonal storage 
In harsh winter weather, cover the piece or move it under shelter, and keep the cushions indoors.

sedbergh-round-boucle-bar-stools-set-2.c:
Bouclé upholstery 
The polyester fabric carries cleaning code S, which means spot cleaning only, with a water-free dry-cleaning solvent. Never use water or steam. Vacuum regularly to lift dust. Blot spills straight away rather than rubbing. Before using any cleaner, test it first on a small area out of sight. If a loop snags, trim it with small scissors rather than pulling it. Wood frame 
Dust with a soft, dry cloth, and wipe occasionally with a barely damp one, drying straight after. Keep out of direct sun and away from radiators and heat vents. Metal footrest 
Wipe with a soft, dry cloth, or a barely damp one, drying after. A Note on Natural Variation 
Where natural materials such as wood are used, slight variations in grain and colour from one piece to the next are to be expected, and give each its own character.

tavira-adjustable-wicker-outdoor-chaise-.m: Single outdoor chaise lounge woven in a flat, tight synthetic rattan over an aluminum frame finished in powder coat that resists water and UV, on pads that protect surfaces. The back section adjusts. One full-length 5.5 in cushion of dense foam with zippered covers of 100% polyester outdoor fabric that resist water. Holds up to 330 lbs. Assembly required.
tavira-adjustable-wicker-outdoor-chaise-.c:
Outdoor cushions 
The cushion covers are a water-resistant polyester made for outdoor use, and they zip closed over the foam. Deal with spills straight away: work the mark gently with a soft-bristled brush, a little mild soap and lukewarm water, then rinse until no soap remains and let the fabric air dry. Washing by hand is kindest to the fabric and helps it last. Keep bleach and fabric softener away from it. After rain, stand the cushions on edge so they drain and dry right through. Resin wicker 
Brush the weave with a soft brush to lift dust and leaves from the gaps, then wipe with mild soapy water, rinse and let it dry fully. Avoid pressure washers and harsh cleaners. Aluminum frame 
The powder-coated aluminum frame sits inside the weave and does not rust; no separate care is needed beyond keeping the weave clean. Foot pads 
Check the non-marking pads now and then and keep them clean of grit, so the piece moves without marking deck boards, stone or tile. Seasonal storage 
In harsh winter weather, cover the piece with a breathable cover or store it somewhere dry and airy. Bring cushions indoors for the off season.

torquay-basket-weave-wicker-outdoor-armc.c:

Brush the weave with a soft brush to lift dust and leaves from the gaps, then wipe with mild soapy water, rinse and let it dry fully. Avoid pressure washers and harsh cleaners. Aluminum frame

Check the foot caps now and then and keep them clean of grit, so the piece moves without marking deck boards, stone or tile. Seasonal storage

ystad-arched-arm-chair.m: Sculptural accent chair whose arched solid wood arms curve down into the legs, with a gently reclined seat, in faux shearling over high-resilience foam, with glides to protect floors. Assembly required.
ystad-arched-arm-chair.c:
Faux shearling upholstery 
Spot clean only, with a dry-cleaning solvent that contains no water. Never use water or steam on the fabric. Blot any spill straight away rather than rubbing, and try a cleaner on a hidden spot first. Vacuum regularly with a brush attachment, and keep out of prolonged direct sun, which fades fabric over time. Timber frame 
Dust with a soft, dry cloth, and wipe occasionally with a barely damp one, drying after. Keep out of direct sun and away from radiators to protect the wood. A note on natural variation 
Where natural materials such as wood are used, slight variations in grain and colour from one piece to the next are to be expected, and give each its own character.

yvoire-woven-back-dining-chairs-set-2.m: Set of two armless dining chairs on solid hardwood frames in Honey with tapered legs and a back panel of woven faux rattan. The foam-padded seats are covered in heathered woven fabric, Heathered Ink, Heathered Dove or Heathered Cream, with glides underfoot. Each holds up to 507 lbs.
yvoire-woven-back-dining-chairs-set-2.c:
Woven upholstery 
The woven fabric carries cleaning code S, which means spot clean only, with a water-free dry-cleaning solvent. Never use water or steam on it. Blot any spill straight away rather than rubbing, test the cleaner on a small hidden spot first, and vacuum regularly with a brush attachment to lift dust before it settles in. Keep out of prolonged direct sun, which fades fabric over time. Wood frame 
Dust with a soft, dry cloth, and wipe occasionally with a barely damp one, drying straight after. Keep out of direct sun and away from radiators and heat vents to protect the wood. Woven back 
Brush or vacuum gently with a soft brush attachment to lift dust from the weave, and wipe with a barely damp cloth when needed, drying after. Keep out of prolonged direct sun and away from heat. A Note on Natural Variation 
Where natural materials such as wood are used, slight variations in grain and colour from one piece to the next are to be expected, and give each its own character.

zafra-curved-back-boucle-dining-chairs-s.m: Set of two armless dining chairs with padded, curved backs and splayed back legs, in soft bouclé, Cream or Dove, over a hidden metal frame, with glides to protect floors. The fabric is spun from recycled plastic bottles and certified to a recognised textile safety standard. Also work as desk, guest or accent chairs. Holds up to 300 lbs.
zafra-curved-back-boucle-dining-chairs-s.c:
Bouclé upholstery 
The bouclé carries cleaning code S, which means spot cleaning with a water-free dry-cleaning solvent only, never water or steam. Test the cleaner on a small, hidden area before use. Vacuum regularly to keep dust from settling in, and blot spills straight away rather than rubbing. If a loop snags, trim it with small scissors rather than pulling it.

zierikzee-adjustable-side-table.m: Round side table that adjusts to five heights on a telescoping upright, with a tempered glass top on a steel tube frame in Chrome or Jet. The open C-shaped base slides under a sofa or bed, with caps underfoot. For drinks, trays, a laptop or a plant. Holds up to 17 lbs. Arrives assembled.
zierikzee-adjustable-side-table.c:
Metal frame 
Wipe the steel frame with a soft, dry cloth, or a barely damp one, drying after. Avoid abrasive pads and harsh cleaners, which can dull or scratch the finish. Glass 
Clean the tempered glass top with a glass cleaner or mild soapy water on a soft, lint-free cloth. Avoid abrasive pads and scouring powders, and use coasters under hot cups.

zoagli-upholstered-seat-dining-chairs-se.m: Set of two armless dining chairs on hardwood frames in Blonde or Chestnut with tapered legs and an angled, open back. The cushioned seat is covered in Oyster heathered woven fabric. Seat height 19.5 in, for a standard dining table, and they suit a desk too. Holds up to 507 lbs. Assembly required.

zwolle-twin-light-mushroom-table-lamp.m: Two-light table lamp with a metal cone base and dome shade in Jet, Brass or Silver, on a 71-inch black cord with an on/off switch along it. Takes two E26 bulbs up to 60 watts each or LED equivalents, not included. Works with a dimmer, not included. Assembly required.
zwolle-twin-light-mushroom-table-lamp.c:
Metal 
Dust with a soft, dry cloth, or wipe with a lightly dampened soft cloth, then dry it straight away. Avoid abrasive pads and harsh cleaners, which can scratch or dull the finish. Bulbs and wiring 
Switch off and let the bulbs cool before cleaning or changing them. Use two E26 bulbs of no more than 60 watts each, or LED equivalents. A Note on Finish 
Painted and plated metal finishes can read a shade warmer or cooler from one screen to the next and from one production run to another, and small variations in tone are to be expected.
